motivation: Correct implementation defects documented by the immutable read-only audit; results may not replace or be pooled with the preregistered pilot.

controller.controller_amendment_policy: Any replacement requires a new exploratory protocol version before outcomes are observed.

transparent_wrapper_amendment_20260918.reason: Isaac 4.5 PickPlace event interpolation was observed to advance before this standalone Franka articulation was dynamically settled; the official controller and its RMPFlow core remain unchanged.
transparent_wrapper_amendment_20260918.outcome_status: thresholds fixed before exploratory c19 execution
transparent_wrapper_amendment_20260918.robot_base_amendment_reason: The condition-invariant object target at world x about 0.25 entered a dynamically singular low pose relative to a base at x 0; shifting only the shared robot base makes relative x about 0.45 without changing task geometry or success predicates.
transparent_wrapper_amendment_20260918.shallow_grasp_reason: The frozen base-grid dynamic probe validated 0.08 m as the lowest stable tool height; measured finger collision bottom is about 9.43 mm below tool center, leaving physical overlap with the 0.08 m lid top without an unstable deep insertion.
transparent_wrapper_amendment_20260918.articulation_drive_amendment_reason: With strict pose satisfied under a fixed joint-position and zero-velocity target, PhysX arm-joint speeds remained about 0.12 rad/s; apply one shared damping multiplier without resetting measured state or changing the success gate.
transparent_wrapper_amendment_20260918.c32_outcome_and_withdrawal_before_c33: c32 failed at the 0.13 m waypoint and increased measured maximum arm speed to about 0.211 rad/s; the 2x kd amendment is withdrawn for c33 and later runs.
transparent_wrapper_amendment_20260918.arm_actuator_velocity_amendment_reason: Apply the same real PhysX articulation maximum velocity to all seven Franka arm DOFs while retaining asset-authored finger limits. This changes neither pose/speed success thresholds nor task geometry, and is recorded before c33 outcome observation.
transparent_wrapper_amendment_20260918.wrapper_timeout_amendment_reason: c33 verified the 0.04 rad/s PhysX arm limit but exhausted the prior 1800-frame safe-above budget while still moving at that limit, without contacting the lid. Extend only the wait budget; all pose, orientation, speed, and stable-frame gates remain unchanged.
transparent_wrapper_amendment_20260918.lid_geometry_amendment_reason: c34 strictly validated stable Franka convergence through tool z 0.10 m but not at 0.09 m. Raise the lid, its four supports, access prism, and parking pad together by 0.02 m so the unchanged upper-edge grasp geometry lies in the validated domain; retain all access, containment, stability, and terminal predicates.
transparent_wrapper_amendment_20260918.controller_event0_initialization_before_: c35 exposed that jumping from a completed wrapper preposition directly to official PickPlaceController event 2 leaves its event-0 pick-anchor fields undefined. Before handoff, call the official public forward method once at event 0 without applying the returned redundant motion action, then continue at event 2. Controller core, scene, actions, and success gates are unchanged.
transparent_wrapper_amendment_20260918.lid_grasp_band_alignment_reason: c36 converged strictly at tool z 0.10 m but only contacted the lid's upper edge and lost it during event 4. Raise the unchanged 0.06 m lid and its support/access/parking assembly by 0.02 m so the measured finger collision band crosses the lid body while retaining the validated tool target, container semantics, and every terminal predicate.
transparent_wrapper_amendment_20260918.parking_release_alignment_reason: c37 maintained a real dynamic grasp through transport but released the lid center at about z 0.1445, 54.5 mm above the former stable center. Raise the parking support and open target to the measured release plane. A 0.14 m square pad provides the frozen 0.05 m center tolerance plus the lid 0.02 m half-width; the dynamic target and unchanged terminal distance, access, lift, and stability predicates remain authoritative.

blueprint_inputs: union of reference, nonreference, and deleted actions

physical_proxies.inside: Four collision walls and a bottom form an open-top container; containment uses object AABB fully inside the measured interior volume.
physical_proxies.ontop: A raised collision support is instantiated; success requires object bottom above the support top and XY footprint overlap.
physical_proxies.open: A dynamic lid initially intersects the frozen access prism; success requires lid in its parking slot and zero lid/access AABB overlap.
physical_proxies.close: The same lid returns to the closed slot and overlaps the frozen access prism.
physical_proxies.toggle_on: A dynamic switch token moves from a labeled off fixture to a spatially distinct on fixture.
physical_proxies.toggle_off: The same token moves from the on fixture to the off fixture.

first_gate: One task, all three conditions, seed 1001, explicitly non-formal exploratory dry-runs.
